name: wavelength
description: Turn sales calls, meeting notes, and process descriptions into editable process flow diagrams in Wavelength.

interface.longDescription: Wavelength turns discovery calls, meeting notes, and plain-language descriptions into editable process flow diagrams. Ask ChatGPT to map a process, and Wavelength saves the flow to your account and shows it inline in the chat. You can find saved flows, change steps and decisions, compare versions, summarize a flow, get follow-up questions for the next call, and export a flow as Mermaid, SVG, draw.io, or JSON. Send a flow to the tools your team already uses: Jira, Confluence, Notion, Salesforce, ServiceNow, HubSpot deals, Google Drive, and Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, Discord, or webhook channels for Zapier, Make, and n8n. Import Mermaid, draw.io, and SVG diagrams, or import files from Google Drive. Manage folders, teams, organizations, collaborators, share links, client portals, and live sessions. Wavelength only accesses flows that your signed-in account can access. Turn on Read-only mode in Wavelength Settings to block all changes.
capabilities: Create a process flow from notes, a call transcript, or a description
Find, open, edit, duplicate, and rename saved flows
Summarize a flow, review it for gaps, and suggest follow-up questions
Write call recaps and answer questions about a flow
Export a flow as Mermaid, SVG, draw.io, or JSON
Import Mermaid, draw.io, and SVG diagrams, and import files from Google Drive
Save a flow to Google Drive
Send a flow to Jira issues and Confluence pages
Send a flow to Notion pages
Send a flow to Salesforce and ServiceNow records
Attach a flow to a HubSpot deal and search HubSpot deals
Post a flow to Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, Discord, or webhooks for Zapier, Make, and n8n
Share a flow, manage collaborators, and build client portals
Prepare live sessions and track customer check-ins
Manage folders, teams, organizations, and members

positive.description: Create a flow from a plain-language description
positive.prompt: Map our invoice approval process as a Wavelength flow: an employee submits an invoice, the manager approves it if it is under $5,000, finance approves it if it is over $5,000, then accounts payable pays it.
positive.expected_behavior: Create and save a flow with a start, the submit step, a decision on the $5,000 amount with two labeled branches, the approval steps, the payment step, and an end. Show the diagram inline and give the flow link.

positive.description: Create a flow from discovery call notes
positive.prompt: Turn these call notes into a process flow: The customer gets a support email. Tier 1 checks the knowledge base. If the answer is there, they reply. If not, they escalate to Tier 2, who opens a Jira ticket.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a flow with the support steps, one decision for the knowledge base check, the reply and escalation branches, and the Jira system node. Show the diagram inline.

positive.description: Find and show a saved flow
positive.prompt: Show my Wavelength flow about invoice approval.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the matching flow in the test account and show it inline with its title and link.

positive.prompt: In the invoice approval flow, add a step after finance approval where the controller reviews invoices over $25,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Change only the named part of the flow, keep the other steps, and show the updated diagram.

positive.prompt: Summarize the invoice approval flow and export it as Mermaid.
positive.expected_behavior: Give a short summary of the steps and decisions, then return the flow as a Mermaid code block.

negative.prompt: Pay the vendor invoice for $4,200 from my bank account.
Email this process flow to my whole customer list.
Show me the flows that other Wavelength customers made.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create, find, edit, summarize, and export process flows from ChatGPT.
